b6_reason: The correct ratio is sqrt(2) : 1, but options 1 and 2 are identical strings after extraction damage, so which one carries the square root cannot be determined.
b6_working: Disc about central normal axis: I = MR^2/2, so k1 = R/sqrt(2). Disc about a diameter: I = MR^2/4, so k2 = R/2. k1 : k2 = (R/sqrt(2)) / (R/2) = 2/sqrt(2) = sqrt(2). Ratio = sqrt(2) : 1.
